title: The Jacobians of symbolic user functions by the automatic differentiation of exudyn.symbolic
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG12.54: instead of central differences, the Jacobian of a symbolic user function (position, rotation, constraint, residual) could be derived by esym.Diff - per coordinate q[i] and q_t[i] it works now, but slowly; to be analyzed: a derivative as one more flat program, and whether n derivatives of a function of n arguments need a local stack of their own.
releaseNotes: superseded by #3163: the numbers of the Jacobians are given by the one-pass derivative (#3116) and the table (#3157); the derivative as new nodes is a column of the table of operations, #3163
